title: 🔅🔅TEHRAN, NOVEMBER 5 – Mohammad Javad Larijani, senior expert on international affairs and head of the Institute for Research in Fundamental Sciences, said Parliament must halt implementation of the NPT, US has no right to decide on Iran’s enrichment level.
text: 🔅🔅TEHRAN, NOVEMBER 5 – Mohammad Javad Larijani, senior expert on international affairs and head of the Institute for Research in Fundamental Sciences, said Parliament must halt implementation of the NPT, US has no right to decide on Iran’s enrichment level.
